items.title: Polo Managing Agency to manage Allianz Commercial’s new Lloyd’s syndicate 1893
items.summary: Polo Managing Agency has been appointed to manage Allianz Commercial's new Lloyd's syndicate, which is scheduled to start trading at the beginning of 2027.

items.title: BlackRock launches protected equity strategy for UK pension schemes
items.summary: BlackRock has introduced a protected equity fund for UK defined benefit and defined contribution pension schemes to help manage downside market risks.

items.title: Skipton Building Society gains Living Pension Employer accreditation
items.summary: Skipton Building Society has secured Living Pension Employer accreditation from the Living Wage Foundation in recognition of its enhanced pension provisions.

items.title: Climate warming scenarios could reduce long-term pension fund returns by up to 30%
items.summary: Ortec Finance analysis indicates that temperature increases of 2°C to 3°C by the end of the century could significantly lower investment performance for pension schemes.

items.title: Brokers point to rising risk of underinsurance in non-standard market
items.summary: Insurance Age reports that Prestige Underwriting survey data highlights incorrect property valuations as a primary driver of underinsurance among brokers.

items.title: River UK Micro Cap proposes cash exit for up to 50% of share capital
items.summary: Investment Week reports that the River UK Micro Cap trust has proposed a cash exit mechanism capped at half of its issued share capital.
